acceptanceCriteria: The immutable v0.2.91 tag and existing public Release remain unchanged and their identities are verified
The published handoff is bound to the immutable v0.2.91 source and current workflow orchestration identity
Public fresh installation and public N-1 upgrade consume downloaded Release artifacts in isolated environments and retain clean receipts
Version consistency and release close pass with structured dependency results and no absent-artifact download noise
A failed recovery stage can resume from the applicable persisted stage without repeating successful publication or deleting resources
goal: prove the v0.2.91 handoff, public fresh installation, public N-1 upgrade, version consistency, and structured close without mutating the existing tag or Release
intent: complete the already-published v0.2.91 recovery acceptance against its immutable public artifacts

scenarioCoverage.expected: the recovery confirms the existing Release and does not overwrite its tag or assets
scenarioCoverage.scenario: existing immutable Release is reused after publication handoff failure
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: inspect the final hosted recovery log and compare the immutable tag, Release manifest, and asset digests before and after recovery

scenarioCoverage.expected: handoff failure prevents public acceptance and close downloads only successful dependency receipts
scenarioCoverage.scenario: public acceptance starts only after a successful publication handoff
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: inspect the final recovery job graph and release close receipt for dependency-gated acceptance and structured skipped results
